title: Introduce stage-aware lint gate and rollback-safe dependency updater
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: our monorepo lint and dependency-upgrade flow has produced noisy premerge failures and occasional post-release dependency regressions when staged releases skip nonblocking lint checks. This PR introduces a stage-aware lint gate that enforces stricter checks on release branches while allowing fast-feedback lanes to remain permissive, plus a rollback-safe dependency updater that annotates and stages transitive bump candidates for safe canary promotion. Summary of changes: added a new CI component (ci/lint-stage-gate) that tags PRs based on branch policies and changed files; extended the dep-updater to emit a signed metadata blob (deps/metadata.json.sig) consumed by deployment tooling; added a small local CLI shim (tools/dep-guard) to run the updater locally and validate rollback markers. Key goals: reduce release-blocking flakes, make dep bumps revertible without manual intervention, and maintain fast developer iteration on feature branches. Checklist: [x] Add stage-aware lint gate job and orchestration; [x] Update dependency updater to write rollback metadata and version pins; [x] Wire dep metadata consumption into release-smoke job; [x] Add unit and integration tests for new CI validations; [x] Add docs for workflow owners. Testing & validation: ran staged pipeline against internal test-repo with 36 sample PRs (fastpath and release lanes); verified lint gate blocks on main->release merges but allows quickpath for feature/* branches; simulated failed upgrade where rollback metadata triggered automatic reversion in the canary job. Rollout & rollout plan: feature flagged under ci.feature.stageGate; initial rollout to nightly branch runs for one week; opt-in for two internal teams (runtime and sdk) for canary; enable org-wide after telemetry shows <1% false positives for 7 days. Observability: emit metrics lint_gate.evaluations.{allowed,blocked}, dep_updater.bump_candidates, dep_updater.rollback_invocations; added dashboards and alerts for spikes. Backout/rollback: the dep metadata includes a rollback_sha and rollback_plan; release-smoke will attempt automatic rollback on dependency regression detection and open a SUP ticket if automatic attempts fail. Related work: complements ENG-2789 (incremental test catalogs) and ENG-2451 (staged CI lanes). Migration notes: repository owners should add branch annotation files for release branches (ci/branch-policies/*.yaml). Security: signed metadata uses existing CI signing key; access to dep-guard is restricted via maintainer-only ACL in action. Impact: expected small initial uptick in chore PRs to pin transient transitive deps but large reduction in release blips and manual rollbacks.

review_comments: Arjun Patel: Please ensure the lint gate's allowlist is configurable by path; I hit a case where generated code produced false positives — author: added branch and path allowlist support and defaulted generated/ to be ignored
Priya Rao: Can we avoid expanding pipeline run-time by more than 30s for quickpath PRs? — author: optimized rule evaluation into a single Golang evaluation binary and remeasured 12s median overhead
Luis Gomez: Signing key rotation — how do we re-sign older metadata? — author: added re-sign tool and fallback verifier that accepts a historical keyset stored in ci/keys/rotations.json
CI Bot: linux-unit-tests failed on first run (flaky network); rerun passed — author: re-ran CI, attached logs and added retry to network fetch in tests
